note: SCOPE, AND THE SIBLING THAT CARRIES THE REST. This task was contracted MATERIAL-ONLY: its intent put "any change to the three arms semantics" explicitly out of scope, and its AC-5 required the arms to keep their semantics untouched. The measurement that ran under it then showed the material was NOT sufficient on its own — with the claims and the test content carried, four runs against the configured provider still returned human and none returned accept, because the arm required a FLAWLESS review and a text reviewer asked to say when it cannot verify a criterion always has something to say. So the delivery splits: this task is the material (claims + criterion-level evidence, commit review-material-carries-claims), and the ARM CORRECTION is 12-operate-loop/24-implementation-verdict-arm, spawned the same day with its own grill. AC-3 here (the accept arm fires, demonstrated) is therefore met JOINTLY — the demonstration was run after both landed, and 24 carries it. The material commits are not re-scoped; nothing here is withdrawn.

THE CRITERION-LEVEL EVIDENCE IS CARRIED, SELECTED BY A DERIVED RULE AND BOUNDED WITH ITS BOUND STATED. A new `submission.tests` section carries, at the anchor sha, the full text of every test file the REVIEWED RANGE changes — selected from `git diff --name-only <range>` filtered to test paths, never hand-authored — bounded at 40000 chars with the cut disclosed inline in the same shape the patch uses ('+N chars cut'). MEASURED EFFECT on the delivered bytes: the assembled material for 12/13 on the clone grew 80,267 to 122,749 chars and `it(` occurrences went 0 to 72. Tests pin both: real test bytes are present for a real range, and the cut plus the selection note are stated.

THE ACCEPT ARM FIRES, DEMONSTRATED AND NOT ASSERTED — and the honest form of this claim is JOINT. Run on this task's own material alone, the worker returned human on every one of four runs against the configured provider, because the arm then required a FLAWLESS review (see the `extended` note on this node: the arm correction is scope-split to 12-operate-loop/24-implementation-verdict-arm). After BOTH landed, the demonstration was run end to end on the clone: task 12/11 (seven matches, one uncertain, no defect) submitted at confirm, the worker returned accepted (10 findings), the confirm event records decider: worker with its run id, and the task CLOSED — auto-close through the existing writer, no new event type and no second write path. The why it recorded reads 'the review walked every criterion and left no defect open (10 finding(s)) — CARRIED WITH 3 OPEN QUESTION(S), raised and not decided'. The harness (tmp/ann-review/call.mjs plus prompt.mjs) assembles the exact production prompt and calls the same abilities.llm.complete, so the claim can be re-checked rather than believed.

WHAT CANNOT BE CARRIED IS STATED, NOT SILENT. The selection note travels with the test material and names what falls outside it — runtime behaviour no test text carries (a real browser, a real network) and any test file the range does not touch — so an uncertain raised against a known limit is a STATED boundary rather than a surprise. This is pinned by the second AC-2 test, which asserts the note's presence and its text. HONEST LIMIT: the note names the TEST selection's limits; the DIFF's own limit (a criterion whose answer lives in unchanged code) is disclosed by the patch's existing cut line and was NOT closed by this task — the demonstration showed the reviewer still asking for diff hunks the path-ordered cut dropped, which is recorded as its own idea rather than claimed here.

NO REGRESSION. The full suite is green (55 files, 1115 tests), typecheck and build are clean, and the journey reads clean (ann check: no gate gaps) with the log agreeing with the filesystem (ann verify: 0 drifts) — all five captured by the engine against the delivered bytes. The material change is additive: it adds two context sections and touches no existing one, the findings shape and the severity vocabulary are untouched, and the actor that decides is still the same deterministic rule over the same ONE writer. The claims carried in the material are the SAME facts the card and the floor read (`brief`), so the worker and the human still cannot read different records.
